title: card frontmatter (working-on/<slug>.md, working-on/done/<slug>.md)
$comment: Hestia 0042 (frontmatter-fact-ledger, crossing agent-slack 0022). The laptop indexer checks a card's frontmatter against this schema before it writes a `card` fact; a card that fails is a counted warning and gives no fact (it is still read for the kb as before). Owner: Hephaistos. Every field is optional, so cards written before 0042 stay valid; an empty key reads as null. Unknown keys are allowed. Ledgers (expected.json accepted_reading.ledgers) are not cards and are never checked.

status.description: kept as written; expected.json card_statuses and done_folder say how it is read

review.description: pass or fail once reviewed; kept as written

created.description: NEW (0042): the day the card was cut (YYYY-MM-DD, or RFC 3339 with an offset)

done.description: NEW (0042): the day the card reached done (YYYY-MM-DD, or RFC 3339 with an offset)

review_rounds.description: NEW (0042): how many review rounds the card took; 1 is a first-time pass

list.description: a list field: a list, or one scalar read as a one-item list (expected.json list_fields.rule)
